summary: Mother of Wernher von Braun with royal ancestry.

summary: Military and administrative Head of the German Peenemünde test site.

summary: German physicist and supervisor of Wernher von Braun's doctoral thesis.

summary: American astronaut who first stepped on the surface of the Moon.

name: John F. Kennedy
summary: US President who initiated the Lunar Program.

summary: University where Wernher von Braun studied starting in 1930.
